annotation.authors_or_issuer: State Council and Central Military Commission of the PRC (国务院、中央军委)
key_provisions_or_claims: Classifies drones into micro, light, small, medium and large by weight and performance, with graded requirements.
Airworthiness certificates required for medium and large civil drones; operator certificates for operations.
Flight applications to air traffic management must be filed the day before, with emergency exceptions.
Real-name registration, unique product identification codes and mandatory liability insurance.
Graded fines, license suspension and confiscation for violations; counter-drone equipment restricted.
annotation.summary_en: China's Interim Regulations on the Administration of Unmanned Aircraft Flight (State Council Decree No. 761, effective 1 January 2024). It sets weight-based drone classes, airworthiness and operator licensing, registration, insurance, airspace control and flight approval, with penalties for violations.
